snippet.title: Taking the Stairs vs the Elevator. For One Floor?
snippet.description:
Taking the elevator for one floor? Cella's sister has notes: "Bold choice, for someone with legs." Cella turns around and takes the stairs. The elevator arrives empty.

Is taking the stairs instead of the elevator worth it? One flight won't change your life. But it's movement you'd otherwise skip. Small choices like this add up when they become a habit.

Our family takes the stairs.

NAOS · Choose friction.

snippet.title: No Phone in the Morning: Cella Lasted Four Minutes
snippet.description:
No phone in the morning, day one: Cella lasted four minutes. The neighbors saw everything. Day two, she puts the phone in the drawer and walks right past it.

How do you stop checking your phone first thing in the morning? Most people who manage it don't rely on willpower. They put the phone somewhere they can't reach from bed, like a drawer or another room, and start small: 10 minutes without it, then 30, then until after breakfast.

A cartoon about building a no-phone morning routine, one morning at a time.

snippet.title: 19 YouTube subscribers. Cella wants 1,000 views by Wednesday
snippet.description:
19 YouTube subscribers, and Cella just set a goal: 1,000 views by Wednesday.

Cella is the NAOS mascot, a small dark doorway-shaped figure with a red crown. This channel has 19 subscribers today (counted Nov 22, 2026), and this Short is day 0 of her public challenge. The bar starts empty at 0.
